fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Not replicated. Windows adder bg3.exe+0x1EEB910 (allocates 0x68 bytes for the type) zeroes +0 and +8; the AI caller bg3.exe+0x305BF70 copies a 16-byte value from bg3.exe+0x4130AA0 here, the other caller bg3.exe+0x3357210 leaves it 0. Live: always 0 (3 instances). 16 bytes; Guid by width.

fields.name: Level
fields.evidence: Adder writes 0xFFFFFFFF (null FixedString). bg3.exe+0x305BF70 stores the FixedString at +8 of a component of the requesting entity (ls::LevelComponent's LevelName in Script Extender) with IncRef/DecRef; bg3.exe+0x3357210 assigns a FixedString via bg3.exe+0x412E090. Live: an FS index.

fields.name: Start
fields.evidence: Adder zeroes +0x14..+0x1F. bg3.exe+0x305BF70 copies the requester's current position (its +0x6C..+0x74) here. Live: (48.75, 18.3, -420.8).

fields.name: Goal
fields.evidence: Adder zeroes +0x20..+0x2B. bg3.exe+0x305BF70 copies the requester's +0x38..+0x40 (the destination), bg3.exe+0x3357210 a computed target position. Live: (51.25, 17.21, -415.8), a few metres from Start.

fields.name: field_2C
fields.evidence: Adder 0. Both callers store the result of bg3.exe+0x2AE4B10(world, entity) here. Live: 0.

fields.name: field_30
fields.evidence: Adder: 6. bg3.exe+0x305BF70 stores a byte read from another component of the entity (2 when absent); bg3.exe+0x3357210 a byte result. Live: 0.

fields.name: _Pad31
fields.evidence: Never written by the Windows adder (only the byte at +0x30 is set), live bytes here vary (0x10 at +0x31, 0x01/0x80 at +0x34..+0x37): uninitialised padding before the 8-aligned set.

fields.name: field_38
fields.evidence: Adder zeroes +0x38..+0x67. Both callers insert EntityHandles with bg3.exe+0x1136A10, a HashSet insert (buckets pointer/count at +0, next-ids array at +0x10, 8-byte keys at +0x20, hash = key % bucket count); bg3.exe+0x3357210 inserts the requester and the target. Live: buckets pointer with count 5, two 2-element arrays. Probably entities the path search ignores.

open_questions: Server-only in the samples (client row also registers 104 bytes).

Offsets/widths of every member are established by the Windows adder and the two writers; names of field_0, field_2C, field_30, field_38 are not. Name 'Level' assumes the source component is ls::LevelComponent.
Guid at +0: by width only (always zero live).
